Subject: Quick: MAP kickoff & timeline for MedSync POC

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Jared and I chatted this morning and we're excited to move into a short POC to validate throughput and accuracy on our scheduling transcripts. We have a tight window: the procurement team wants a signed SOW and initial metrics by the end of June so leadership can decide on a Q3 rollout.

We have a rough list of success criteria and a short sample corpus attached. Before we lock dates, can we do a MAP kickoff to align owners, benchmarks, and what a completed evaluation looks like? Suggested agenda:
- Confirm success metrics (latency targets, F1 on entity extraction, hallucination tolerances)
- Agree on prompt/eval owners and access to sample data
- Timeline and gating for procurement/signing

I can make time tomorrow afternoon or Thursday morning PT.

Attachments: medsync_poc_requirements.pdf (pdf)

Olivia Barnes
Head of Product, MedSync
olivia@medsync.ai

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: MAP kickoff & timeline for MedSync POC

Hi Olivia — great to hear, and thanks for the materials.

We're available for a 45-minute MAP kickoff tomorrow 2:00–2:45pm PT or Thursday 9:30–10:15am PT. I'll propose the earlier slot tomorrow and we can move if that doesn't work.

Draft kickoff outline (high level):
1) Introductions & scope (5 min) — confirm which product flows to include (scheduling transcripts, clinical notes redaction)
2) Success criteria (10 min) — concrete targets: token latency < 300ms p50 for 512 tokens; entity extraction F1 > 0.88 on test slice; end-to-end throughput target = 25 reqs/s
3) Benchmark plan & data access (10 min) — who owns labeling, data upload cadence, acceptable synthetic augmentation
4) Prompt and eval ownership (10 min) — designate prompt steward, eval steward, and fallbacks
5) Timeline & procurement gates (5 min) — SOW, test-signoff, go/no-go decision points

Owners I propose from Redwood:
- Prompt steward: aisha_rahman (prompt tuning + template ops)
- Eval steward: priyom_das (bench harness, automated scoring)
- Runtime lead (throughput/latency): karthik_iyer (config & routing)

Can you confirm owners on your side (who will own labeling, acceptance, and procurement)? I'll upload a draft MAP spreadsheet after the call (attached: redwood_map_v1.xlsx).

If tomorrow 2pm works I'll send a calendar invite with the dial-in and scout the shared Drive link for data transfer.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
